limitations: Exact material-curve policy is a declared geometric diagnostic over binary stored source polyline/arc data and exact composed lineage. It does not replace, clamp or normalize any original or numerical sewing row.
The policy is not an unsampled analytic stitch curve or automatically identical to the original tolerant point-embedding implementation; explicit curve-versus-point-row operator defects are retained.

Exact squared-gap extrema cover the complete spatial curve only at each supplied static state. Decimal100 length values are reporting approximations, not independently correctly-rounded square-root certificates.
No source-engine/split admission, dynamics, force, strain acceptance, contact/intersection/trajectory certificate, stitch mechanics, material side, construction, or garment acceptance is performed.
Endpoint nondegeneracy and positive start-normal dot do not certify a contact-safe motion. The constructed deformation is a nullspace counterexample, not a solver trajectory.
Physical stitching, a continuous scalar target field, activation/release semantics, and joint space-time bounds require additional explicitly declared models and verification.
constructedGeometryWitness.positionArrayScope: Full positions and exact changed coordinates remain in ignored raw witnesses; no numerical state arrays are included here.
constructedGeometryWitness.scalarTargetInterpolation: Not defined or accepted by this witness. Existing five scalar targets remain unchanged; continuous gap is reported directly, separately from point-row target errors.

developmentFindings: The original five sampled operators do not define an exact continuous material field. The explicit captured-polyline policy reports every coefficient discrepancy and never replaces the rows.
Exact material-coordinate lineage does not constrain arbitrary refined deformed positions to the original finite-element interpolation.
Thirty-seven positive member cells have distinct exact endpoints that round to identical binary64 fractions; none may be collapsed.

The auditor tightened raw-row validation for unexpected owners, missing anchors, duplicate or zero terms, incorrect coefficient signs and Boolean indices after its initial twelve-test native pass. Its final thirteen-test native/Linux runs preserve valid arithmetic.
The first default-sandbox focused Linux auditor invocation could not reach the Docker socket; its log is retained separately. The authorized container run completed all thirteen tests.
An initial plot invocation used the numerical environment, which lacks matplotlib; the figure was generated with the existing dedicated plot environment. No numerical files changed.

independentAudit.scope: Independent supplied-source exact raw-lineage material coordinates, positive oriented parent tilings, stored arc/position polyline clipping against every original/numerical face, complete rational partitions, shared-edge point-operator equality, exact pullbacks and all eight selectors/forty preserved-row discrepancies. Original pattern and split-geometry rederivation remain a separate strict validator prerequisite. No producer, pattern engine, solver or force model is imported. This audit does not evaluate a posed state, install continuum constraints, choose normal directors/textile sides, certify temporal/contact paths or grant physical stitching/construction acceptance.

limitations: Static source-bound material-curve mapping only; no controls installed, refined motion executed or captured source admitted.
